question: Where was the Khelo India Winter Games, 2025, First Phase, held from 23 January?
solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Leh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first phase** of the **5th edition** of the **Khelo India Winter Games 2025** was officially held in **Leh, Ladakh**.
 
• The event commenced on **23 January 2025** and concluded on **27 January 2025**, marking a significant milestone for winter sports in the **Union Territory of Ladakh**.
 
• The **first phase** in **Leh** specifically focused on two major sporting disciplines: **Ice Hockey** and **Ice Skating** (including **short track speed skating**).
 
• The games were inaugurated by the **Lieutenant Governor** of **Ladakh**, **Brigadier (Dr.) BD Mishra (Retd)**, alongside officials from the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• The competition saw intense participation from various **States**, **Union Territories**, and the **Services Sports Control Board**, highlighting the growing infrastructure for winter sports in **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Structure of the Games:**
 
 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games 2025** is organized in a **two-phase format**. While the **first phase** took place in **Leh**, the **second phase** is scheduled to be held in **Gulmarg, Jammu & Kashmir**.
 
• The **second phase** typically features events such as **Alpine Skiing**, **Snowboarding**, and **Nordic Skiing**, taking advantage of the slopes in the **Pir Panjal** range.
 
 
 
• **Mascot and Symbolism:**
 
 
• The official **mascot** for the winter games is often the **Snow Leopard**, named **'Sheen-e She'** (or Shan) in the local dialect, symbolizing the spirit of the **Himalayas** and conservation efforts in **Ladakh**.
 
• The logo of the games incorporates the **Dharmachakra** (Wheel of Dharma) and elements representing the mountains, reflecting the cultural heritage of the host regions.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched in **2018**, the **Khelo India** programme is a flagship initiative of the **Government of India** to revive the sports culture at the **grassroots level**.
 
• The **Winter Games** vertical was introduced in **2020** to identify talent for **international competitions** such as the **Winter Olympics** and the **Asian Winter Games**.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** provides financial assistance to identified athletes under the **Talent Development Scheme**.
 
 
 
• **Regional Impact:**
 
 
• Hosting these games in **Leh** boosts **sports tourism** and provides local athletes with **national-level exposure**.
 
• Venues like the **NDS Ice Hockey Rink** in **Leh** have been upgraded to **international standards** to support the **Khelo India** mission.
